title: RVLM-X: Towards a Universal VLM Harness
title_zh: RVLM-X：迈向通用的视觉语言模型推理框架
abstract_en: Harnesses for vision-language models (VLMs) have grown with the models' capabilities, notably for images far larger than those seen in training, where downscaling loses small details. Most of them wrap the VLM in a fixed procedure, such as a zoom tree, that decides in advance where it looks and how the evidence is combined. These procedures make up for the weaknesses of older models by keeping them on a task-specific path, but with frontier models that reliably plan and use tools, they can lower accuracy. We propose RVLM-X, a task-generalizable recursive VLM harness that runs unchanged across photographs, charts and maps. Following the recursive inference of Recursive Language Models, the VLM programmatically controls its own visual context in a code REPL that holds the full-resolution image and calls itself recursively on regions that it chooses. With a cost-efficient frontier model as the base of every method, RVLM-X is more accurate than a single call on all 7 public benchmarks and has the highest pooled accuracy. Because existing benchmarks mostly test whether a model finds one small detail, we also introduce MapGenBench, procedurally generated maps whose questions combine fine-detail perception with multi-step reasoning. There, RVLM-X answers 71.4% of held-out questions against 55.5% for the strongest baseline. Overall, our findings suggest that as VLMs plan and use tools more reliably, letting the model write its own visual search works better than fixing one in advance.
abstract_zh: 处理远超训练分辨率的图像时，缩小图像容易丢失细节。现有视觉语言模型（VLM）推理框架通常采用缩放树等固定流程，预先规定模型查看哪些区域以及如何整合证据。这类流程能弥补早期模型的不足，但也可能限制已具备可靠规划和工具使用能力的前沿模型。本文提出 RVLM-X，一种无需针对照片、图表或地图调整流程的递归推理框架。受 Recursive Language Models 启发，RVLM-X 将全分辨率图像保存在交互式代码环境（REPL）中，让 VLM 编写代码控制可见内容，自主选择图像区域并递归调用自身。在所有对比方法使用同一款高性价比前沿模型的条件下，RVLM-X 在 7 个公开基准上均优于单次调用，汇总准确率最高。作者还推出了程序化生成地图的 MapGenBench，将细节感知与多步推理结合起来；RVLM-X 在留出问题上的准确率为 71.4%，最强基线为 55.5%。
key_points_zh: RVLM-X 在 REPL 中保留原始分辨率，由 VLM 编写代码选择查看区域，并按需递归调用自身。
同一套推理框架可直接用于照片、图表和地图，无需为不同任务预设搜索路径。
在使用相同基础模型的对比中，RVLM-X 在全部 7 个公开基准上均优于单次调用，汇总准确率最高。
MapGenBench 不只考查能否找到局部细节，还要求利用细节完成多步推理；RVLM-X 在留出问题上领先最强基线 15.9 个百分点。
